Markets.title: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
Markets.summary: Taco Bell reported a greater-than-expected decline in third-quarter sales due to a customer traffic drop from a cyclosporiasis outbreak. Despite this setback, same-store sales later recovered to flat levels while the company's overall profits surpassed analysts' predictions.

Markets.title: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker
Markets.summary: Polymarket's PM Derivatives unit has received National Futures Association approval to act as a broker. The company still requires Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval to expand its operations while facing a CFTC investigation over its marketing practices.

Markets.title: US midterms put Trump-era crypto boom and prediction markets at risk
Markets.summary: A Democratic takeover of Congress in the US midterms could end the crypto-friendly regulatory environment established under President Donald Trump. This potential shift threatens to bring stricter oversight for digital assets and prediction markets, pressuring companies like Coinbase, Strategy, and Bullish.

Markets.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
Markets.summary: CleanMax beat analyst EBITDA estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company reported a 58% increase in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold rise in profit after tax.

Markets.title: Bagmane REIT declares Rs 527cr distribution to unitholders for September quarter
Markets.summary: Bagmane Prime Office REIT announced a Rs 527 crore distribution to unitholders for the September quarter. During this period, the company leased 1.2 million square feet, achieving a committed occupancy rate of 99 percent.

Markets.title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion funds in a technical breach
Markets.summary: North Korean hackers used fake job interviews and malware to steal $6.34 billion in digital assets from Binance in a technical breach. Binance subsequently froze or intercepted about $2.85 billion of the stolen funds and replenished the rest.

Geo-Political.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
Geo-Political.summary: Seven flights across Poland, Spain, Bulgaria, and Italy were subjected to security checks following separate bomb threats. Authorities confirmed that no explosives have been found on the targeted planes so far.

Geo-Political.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
Geo-Political.summary: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel has died at the age of 30 following an on-field collision. The fatal incident occurred during a Spanish second-division match.

Geo-Political.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
Geo-Political.summary: Binance reports that hackers used fake job interviews on a legitimate platform to target a software engineer. This scheme was part of a broader crypto hack resulting in $6.3 billion in stolen funds.

Geo-Political.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
Geo-Political.summary: Russian attacks on an aid center, hospice, and hospital in Ukraine have killed at least 38 people within 24 hours. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that dozens more individuals may still be trapped beneath the rubble.

Geo-Political.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
Geo-Political.summary: Libya's top religious authority, the Dar al-Ifta, has ruled that wearing Nike clothing is un-Islamic. The decree states that displaying the company's logo is forbidden because the brand is named after the Greek goddess of victory.

Geo-Political.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
Geo-Political.summary: Supermarkets across ten European countries, including Estonia, Sweden, Portugal, and Italy, suffered cyber-attacks targeting their refrigeration systems. The disruptions forced many retailers to discard spoiled food, prompting a continent-wide security alert.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: Why did Pakistan suffer $40 billion in economic losses after trade with India stopped? Which sectors were most affected?
Data & Insights.summary: Pakistan has suffered an estimated $40 billion in economic losses since suspending trade with India in 2019. The Pak-India Business Council reported that the trade halt caused higher import costs, supply delays, and industrial damage, prompting a call to restore commercial ties.

Data & Insights.title: India's illegal gold imports surge 1500% to a three-year high: What's behind the jump?
Data & Insights.summary: India's illegal gold imports surged 1500% to a three-year high. These imports typically bypass official duties through smuggling or individual travelers carrying small quantities in their luggage.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What is driving the surge in GST collections from imported goods?
Data & Insights.summary: GST revenue from imported goods surged 42.2% year-on-year to ₹72,246 crore in October, significantly outpacing domestic growth of 16%. This increase was driven by higher import values, rupee depreciation, and growing demand for industrial inputs.

Data & Insights.title: Can India abolish LTCG tax? SBI Research says Centre has ‘fiscal headroom’ to absorb loss, suggests alternatives
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research states that India has the fiscal capacity to abolish the long-term capital gains tax by fiscal year 2028, absorbing a revenue loss of up to ₹50,000 crore. To offset this, the report suggests increasing the securities transaction tax by 50% and introducing higher exemptions or lower rates for long-term investments.

Data & Insights.title: How policy needs to catch up with India’s upcoming demographic reset
Data & Insights.summary: India still has time before its youthful population profile changes, but the shifting demographics require immediate policy updates. Understanding these mathematical shifts is essential for lawmakers to revise their priorities.

Data & Insights.title: India’s manufacturing growth stays strong as price pressures ease: PMI Manufacturing survey
Data & Insights.summary: India's manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index dropped slightly to 54.7 in October from 55.1 in September. Despite this minor decline, the sector's growth remained strong and well above the neutral threshold of 50.

India.title: Supreme Court Pauses Mumbai Civic Body Chief's Salary Over Encroachments
India.summary: The Supreme Court has halted the Mumbai civic body chief's salary because of unresolved encroachments. The court also denied the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's request for an extra 30 days to finish the work.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi Doubles Down On Debate Dare, Gets A Counter From N Sitharaman
India.summary: JD(U) spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad stated that Rahul Gandhi should raise his concerns in Parliament instead of issuing a debate dare. Prasad emphasized that doing so would demonstrate faith in parliamentary democracy.

India.title: Gujarat Finds 38 Fake Doctors In 15-Day Drive, 35 Charged
India.summary: Gujarat authorities identified 38 suspected fake doctors across the state during a recent 15-day inspection drive. Police have formally charged 35 of the accused individuals, with Rajkot recording the highest number of cases.

India.title: Guns, Grenades, Heroin: Arms, Drug Rackets Busted In Amritsar, 11 Arrested
India.summary: Police in Amritsar arrested 11 people and busted illegal arms and drug trafficking rings. Investigators found that the suspects used drones to smuggle weapons and heroin supplied by foreign-based handlers and gangsters.

India.title: Tamil Nadu Allows 6 am Screenings For New Movies, Theater Owners Celebrate
India.summary: Tamil Nadu has permitted theaters to hold early-morning movie screenings at 6 am. This decision has brought celebration among cinema owners and fans, while also recalling past challenges.

India.title: Bullet Train Connectivity To Guwahati Approved: Himanta Biswa Sarma
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma announced the official approval to bring bullet train connectivity to Guwahati. The long-term project requires multiple stages, including preliminary surveys and the construction of an entirely new railway line.

General.title: How the US midterm results could unfold - as millions of Americans head to the polls
General.summary: Millions of Americans are voting in the US midterm elections as control of Congress hangs in the balance. A BBC North America correspondent examines three potential election outcomes and their implications for the nation.

General.summary: The King described the slave trade as a "shameful chapter" during a Commonwealth address. This speech follows calls for the UK government to issue a formal apology for Britain's historic role in the trade.

General.title: Celebrity loses injunction bid but will stay anonymous pending appeal
General.summary: A court denied an unnamed man's request for an injunction to hide his identity regarding allegations against him. However, he will remain anonymous until his appeal is heard.

General.title: How 'mogging' went from toxic term to mainstream
General.summary: Collins English Dictionary named "mogging" its word of the year after the term transitioned from the manosphere into mainstream everyday discourse. The word originally associated with toxic online communities is now widely used in general conversation.
